# SecureVoice Shield

> SecureVoice Shield is a fraud-prevention platform that helps people and banks verify calls, numbers and voice notes. It never claims a voice is definitely real.

## Golden rule
Shield never calls you first. Never share a PIN, password or one-time code with anyone, including anyone claiming to be Shield.

## Official channels
- Website: https://shield.securevoiceai.me
- Docs: https://docs.shield.securevoiceai.me
- Status: https://status.shield.securevoiceai.me

## Key pages
- [Home](https://shield.securevoiceai.me/) — home and number check
- [Learn](https://shield.securevoiceai.me/en-ug/learn/) — safety lessons
- [Official channels](https://shield.securevoiceai.me/en-ug/official-channels/) — verified contact list
- [Alerts](https://shield.securevoiceai.me/en-ug/alerts/) — active scam alerts

## Locales
en-AE, ar-AE, hi-AE, ur-AE, en-KE, sw-KE, en-UG, lg-UG, sw-UG, en-TZ, sw-TZ

## What Shield never does
- Never calls you first
- Never asks for a PIN, OTP or password
- Never asks you to send money
- Never sends links by SMS
